blocks.value: Two static methods work on the enum type itself, not on an individual constant:

Method       Description                              Example
valueOf()    converts a String into the matching constant   Period.valueOf("PRELIM") returns PRELIM
values()     returns an array of all the constants           Period.values() returns an array of 4 elements
This lets you loop over every constant and let a user pick one by name:

Enums make values type-safe: a variable of type Period can only ever hold PRELIM, MIDTERM, PREFINAL, or FINAL, nothing else.
